summary: Federated learning (FL) keeps raw data local, but most deployments still rely on a trusted coordinator for client admission, checkpoint distribution, update collection, aggregation, and rewards. This paper presents AuditFL, a contract-backed clearing layer for auditable FL in open settings. summary: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on instruction data can quietly erode their safety, even when no training example looks harmful. summary: Robot policy evaluation often relies on a binary success signal for task completion. summary: An effective agent memory system should adapt to a user's history and task requirements. Human-annotated supervision can guide this adaptation by providing feedback for evaluating and improving memory designs. summary: Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery. summary: Proactive agents must decide whether, when, and how far to assist without an explicit request. summary: Recent advances in video world models have enabled the generation of increasingly realistic and interactive virtual environments, opening new possibilities for player-customizable gameplay. summary: In recent years, agentic orchestration has been widely applied to solve complex human tasks.
